decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence and controlling the opponent's actions through a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells. It utilizes Leylines to protect its creatures and Leyline of the Guildpact to boost their power. The inclusion of equipment like Batterskull and Kaldra Compleat adds to the aggressive strategy, while cards like No More Lies and Counterspell help to protect against opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, proactive plays while maintaining control of the battlefield.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of powerful creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It relies on ramping up mana with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Hierarchy to cast big threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and World Breaker early in the game. The deck also includes removal spells like Kozilek's Command and Solitude to deal with opposing threats. By efficiently using mana and aggressive creatures, the deck aims to apply pressure to the opponent and win the game before they can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Amulet of Vigor to cast big threats like Primeval Titan. The deck focuses on assembling lands like Urza's Saga and Lotus Field to generate huge amounts of mana to either win through combat with Primeval Titan or win with combo finishers like Scapeshift. The deck also includes utility lands like Tolaria West and Boseiju, Who Endures to search for key cards and protect important spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big creatures and powerful combo plays.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Lotus Field. It also aims to get Primeval Titan onto the battlefield to search for more lands and create a strong board presence. The deck utilizes cards like Arboreal Grazer and Amulet of Vigor to accelerate its mana production and gain an advantage. By efficiently utilizing the lands and combo pieces, the deck can create overwhelming board states and win the game through a combination of land ramp and powerful creatures.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively burn down the opponent's life total. The deck includes a combination of direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt, Boros Charm, and Lava Spike, alongside efficient creatures like Chandra's Incinerator and Screaming Nemesis to apply pressure. The deck also includes cards like Roiling Vortex and Arena of Glory to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain a fast-paced tempo. By combining burn spells with aggressive creatures, this deck aims to close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and finish them off before they can stabilize. The deck also includes ways to control the opponent's board and protect its own creatures. With a strong mix of creatures and spells, this Boros Aggro deck is designed to be fast and efficient in dealing damage while maintaining a level of control over the game.

This deck aims to utilize the Underworld Breach combo by filling the graveyard with artifacts and then repeatedly casting them from the graveyard with the Breach's ability. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble help with graveyard filling and card draw, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student can help dig for combo pieces. The deck also includes various ways to protect the combo like Spell Snare and malevolent Rumble. Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for artifacts and generating tokens. The deck has a strong focus on generating infinite combos to win the game quickly.

This aggressive deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent using efficient burn spells and fast creatures. It utilizes cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide to apply early pressure, while burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Boros Charm finish off the opponent swiftly. Searing Blaze and Skullcrack help control the board and prevent the opponent from gaining life. The deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize, making it a fast-paced and relentless strategy in Modern 1 vs 1 games.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's board while ramping up mana to quickly play powerful Eldrazi creatures. Using cards like Dress Down and Sink into Stupor to disrupt the opponent's strategy, along with counter spells like Force of Negation, the deck aims to stall the game until it can bring out big threats like Thought-Knot Seer and Sire of Seven Deaths. The Eldrazi Temple and Talisman of Dominance provide the necessary mana acceleration to cast these high-cost creatures, creating a powerful and resilient control archetype.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Sire of Seven Deaths. Control elements such as Chalice of the Void and All Is Dust are used to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and Mystic Forge allows for card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large, hard-to-answer threats while maintaining board control through a combination of removal spells and artifact synergies.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. With a mix of removal spells like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble, as well as versatile cards like Karn, the Great Creator, this deck aims to control the game while steadily building up its board presence with Eldrazi threats. The diversity of threats and removal options make it difficult for opponents to counter effectively, leading to a powerful and resilient control strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to play powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul and Ulamog. It uses cards like Through the Breach and Yggdrasil, Rebirth Engine to cheat out these big threats early in the game. Control elements like Torpor Orb and Kozilek's Command help disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining board advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and powerful Eldrazi abilities, ultimately dominating the late game and securing victory.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly, using cards like Talisman of Creativity and Through the Breach to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog and Emrakul. Control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Command help maintain board presence and disrupt opponents' strategies. With the ability to quickly overwhelm opponents with massive creatures and powerful spells, this deck aims to control the game while ramping up towards an Eldrazi victory.

This Goblin deck focuses on using cards like Conspicuous Snoop and Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker to create powerful combo chains that overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of Goblins. With cards like Aether Vial and Munitions Expert for support, the deck aims to quickly build up a board presence and deal damage efficiently. Utilizing cards like Skirk Prospector and Sling-Gang Lieutenant for sacrifice effects, the deck can also create additional value and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing out threats like Hollow One and Detective's Phoenix early on, leveraging powerful discard and draw cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting to quickly fill the graveyard and enable free, powerful creatures. Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide removal options while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer adds additional pressure and value. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient threats and disruption, utilizing the graveyard as a resource to consistently apply pressure and maintain tempo advantage throughout the game.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and synergies to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It utilizes a mix of creatures with abilities that can deal damage or provide additional value, along with support cards like Prismatic Ending and Expressive Iteration to control the board. The inclusion of Goblin Bombardment and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah allows for additional damage output and removal options. The mana base is well-balanced to support the deck's aggressive strategy, with a mix of land types and mana fixing cards like Marsh Flats and Flooded Strand.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a combo utilizing spells and creatures to deal massive damage without relying on lands. The key strategy involves generating mana through rituals and card draw, while also utilizing cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Sundering Eruption to finish off the opponent. The deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn, taking advantage of the opponent's lack of interaction and dodging traditional removal spells by not relying on lands for mana.

The main concept of this deck is to use powerful combo pieces and control elements to quickly assemble a win condition without relying on traditional land cards. By utilizing cards like Tameshi, Reality Architect and Thundertrap Trainer, along with combo pieces like Goblin Charbelcher and Lotus Bloom, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Control elements such as Disrupting Shoal and Pact of Negation help protect the combo pieces, while cards like Flare of Denial and Sink into Stupor disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck focuses on a unique playstyle that doesn't follow the traditional land-based strategies of Modern format.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays, utilizing low-cost creatures and removal spells to control the board while dealing consistent damage to the opponent. It also includes powerful companions and versatile cards to ensure flexibility in different game situations. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently, using a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to maintain pressure and dictate the pace of the game. By maintaining a balance between aggression and control, the deck can adapt to various matchups and succeed in a competitive 1 vs 1 environment.

The focus of this deck is on aggressive creatures that can be repeatedly blinked or sacrificed for powerful effects. It utilizes cards like Flickerwisp, Solitude, and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Emperor of Bones and Overlord of the Balemurk. By combining aggressive creatures with blink effects like Ephemerate and powerful removal spells like Fatal Push, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while maintaining control of the battlefield.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that have the ability to flicker, or temporarily remove themselves from play and then re-enter the battlefield. By utilizing this mechanic, the deck can continuously reset powerful creatures like Solitude and Phelia, gaining advantage while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The creatures in the deck also synergize well with cards like Ephemerate, allowing for additional flickering effects. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and relentless assault, while also disrupting their plans through flickering and removal spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent by using low-cost aggressive creatures and efficient burn spells. It aims to keep up pressure through consistent damage output and card advantage from cards like Light Up the Stage. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and proactive, aiming to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Searing Blaze helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure on the board.

This Simic Birthing Ritual deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Birthing Rituals, while controlling the board with counterspells like Force of Negation and creatures like Abhorrent Oculus and Ice-Fang Coatl. The deck also utilizes card advantage through Shardless Agent and Coiling Oracle, while having a toolbox of creatures like Kira, Great Glass-Spinner and Floodpits Drowner to deal with different threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast start and efficient interaction, ultimately leading to victory through tempo advantage and efficient use of resources.
